reading.en: No law gives an ordered sequence of phases. Laws of return stand: within finitely many listed configurations every course enters what returns, each basin holding one cycle; a withholding round a loop of p waits returns at every multiple of p; a late relay held below its band crosses it without end past an exact bound. No law gives when a regime cycles or with what period: the regime's cycles are witnesses. 02 lists no universal phase threshold between regions; 05 keeps four routes of transition distinct, none a proved phase transition. Nothing frees stored potential or trades connectedness against resilience. [AI reading]

rulings.why: Its 'cycles are witnesses, with no law of when or with what period' copies plan 4.1's line, which is false: Law.basin_one_cycle, Withholding.withholding_returns and Regulation.held_oscillates stand; only a regime's onset and period are absent (02's where-a-run row, mengzi's entry). Label unchanged.

reading.en: The regulation laws give where the claim holds, in discrete whole amounts: overshoot exactly past the gap; a band a late-reading rule cannot beat, proportional to its lag; a relay reading l steps late settles in its band from every held start exactly where a + (l + 1)M <= b + 1, and past b + 2 <= a + (l + 1)M the start held below crosses both ends without end. So lag alone does not make a corrective loop oscillate; gain against band does. A rule read a step late against its reading alternates, a witness. 08 marks regulation as restating deadbeat control. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Amplification along a supply chain, the period and amplitude of cycles, and structure as the source of behaviour across social systems. No law gives when a regime cycles or with what period (the plan's CY(a)): its cycles are witnesses (Alternation, Relay.cycles). For the late relay the onset of crossing is exact (held_oscillates); its period and amplitude are not stated.

rulings.why: The sense states oscillation as what a lagging corrective loop does; Regulation.relay_threshold conditions it exactly, so scope, as cx-greek-aristotle-mean and cx-syscyb-trap-policy-resistance have the same law; 'the cycles present are witnesses' dropped held_oscillates. The item's summary lists 'delayed correction' as agreement and needs updating.

reading.en: The basin law conditions the first half: within finitely many listed configurations every course enters what returns and each basin holds one cycle, an equilibrium being only its shortest case, with no selector; where no list holds the configurations a course can be drawn and never return (counting on draws 0 and merges nothing). So 'goes to equilibrium' holds within a list, and to a cycle. The second half meets 02's refusal to rank regions and 05's reading that attraction is not continuation. Parts adapted to the rest as organisms go past these laws. [AI reading]

rulings.why: Ashby states it of any determinate system; Law.basin_one_cycle holds within m listed configurations and gives a cycle, and 02 separates an open world. cx-syscyb-eigenforms reads the same law onto 'settles, whatever the start' as scope; fresh-reading with agreement of law was also contradictory by BRIEF. The item's summary lists 'Ashby's recursion into basins' as agreement and needs updating.

account_adds.en: Not the loop: the one-sided case, each with a witness. Below a need with no raising exchange a level does not return (Flow.never_returns_below); where nothing is given below the need, a level below it stays below whatever is drawn, so a later re-reading restores nothing (05, Optimum.gated_stays_below). That branch has no recovery threshold at all: the account's irreversible limit, not a band. An end absorbs while requirements do not loosen; a dissolved requirement is transformation, not recovery. Restoration by joint net giving is a law of every balanced flow.

rulings.why: It called the gated branch 'this crosswalk's composition', but 05's row r-re-optimizing-above-a-renewal-ends-it states it, as cx-indaf-relational-tipping and cx-ecoevo-recovery-beyond-removing-the-pressure cite it; not-carried and the reading stand.
